title: Set up as self-employed (a sole trader)

details.body:
You are probably self-employed if you run your business for yourself and take responsibility for its success or failure.

You need to set up as a sole trader if you earned more than 1,000 pounds from self-employment in the last tax year, or you need to prove you are self-employed, for example to claim Tax-Free Childcare.

Your responsibilities

As a sole trader you must keep records of your business's sales and expenses, send a Self Assessment tax return every year, and pay Income Tax and National Insurance on your profits.
